title: E6 fix round 2: handover and jev_rank stay fail-open when jev.ask raises (found rebasing T-0233 onto the E8 fix)
spec: task/T-0233 (E6 fix round 1, jev_rank + handover) fails after rebasing onto goal/T-0201 (which now has the E8 fix T-0234): tests/test_planner_runs.py::test_jev_triage_exception_still_launches monkeypatches jev.ask to raise RuntimeError('jev endpoint exploded'); planner_runs.run() calls handover.write() before launching, handover now ranks groups through jev_rank, and the exception propagates, so the launch is recorded as failed_launch instead of proceeding. STEP 0: your worktree was cut from goal/T-0201; run `git reset --hard task/T-0233`, confirm `git log --oneline -1` shows the T-0233 commit, then `git rebase goal/T-0201` (expect no conflicts). Fix: jev_rank.rank() wraps the jev.ask call itself in try/except Exception and returns the unranked list on any error; handover's pruning wraps its rank calls the same way and never lets a Jev error reach write(); both paths log one line to stderr at most. Add tests: tests/test_jev_rank.py::test_ask_raising_returns_unranked and tests/test_handover.py::test_handover_survives_jev_exception. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh; commit when green.
acceptance: git log on the task branch contains the T-0233 commit rebased on top of goal/T-0201 head
